systems.platform: 69 pulse readers on household water meters, a planned bulk smart meter, AI anomaly detection, planned dashboard and billing applications
systems.owner: Namibia University of Science and Technology research project, funded by the Science Granting Councils Initiative; no municipal ownership yet
systems.tiers: Ongwediva Extension 11 (pilot, bulk meter and communications not yet commissioned); analysis of 1,375 Windhoek households' data; a phased design proposed for Rundu

note: A research pilot of water-meter sensors and analytics in three towns; it states nothing about the connection of any local authority's own office.
